title: Mistral Releases Weights for Its Trillion-Parameter Model
raw_excerpt: Mistral has released the weights for Mistral Large 4, a trillion-parameter model designed for self-hosted deployment and cybersecurity applications. The company claims leading open-weight performance on agentic coding benchmarks and comparable cybersecurity capabilities to GLM-5.3.
summary: Mistral 发布了 Mistral Large 4 的模型权重，这是一个万亿参数模型，专为自托管部署和网络安全应用设计。官方称其在智能体编程基准上达到开源权重模型的领先水平，网络安全能力与 GLM-5.3 相当。万亿参数开源权重在业内极为罕见，意味着顶级模型能力正从闭源向可自托管生态扩散，对企业和安全敏感场景意义重大。

title: Sam Altman says it’s better for RAM to be in a data center than on your desk
raw_excerpt: Asked about supply chain shortages, like the ongoing RAM shortage , OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said in an interview that it's "terrible" to have RAM in personal PCs instead of data centers. During his appearance on the Cheeky Pint podcast, where he also commented on AI's impact on math , Altman said: "A lot of people want local inference. And somehow, they assume that the problem is solved now because we are going to have open-source models, we're going to be able to run them on our computers, and so we're not going to need all the stuff in the data center. But from a global allocation perspective, actually, it's quite terrible to have everybo … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 在 Cheeky Pint 播客中表示，全球 DRAM 供应紧张的情况下，把内存放在个人 PC 里而非数据中心是“相当糟糕”的。他认为本地推理虽被寄予厚望，但从全球资源分配看，云端最大化利用率才是正解。此番言论直接触及本地 AI 与云端集中化的路线之争，也折射出内存短缺对 AI 基础设施的深层压力。

title: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping
raw_excerpt: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic say they will adopt a new standard that publishers can use to opt out of being scraped by AI, as reported earlier by Search Engine Roundtable . With this control, publishers can apply their AI training preferences across multiple AI companies, instead of setting them individually. The shared "policy token" signal is proposed by Kevin Kelley, a technical lead for standards at Anthropic, as part of the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF). It will live within a website's robots.txt file , which has long signaled which web crawlers can and can't scrape a site - whether for search indexing, archiving, or … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: OpenAI、Google、Microsoft 和 Anthropic 宣布共同采用一项新的网页抓取退出标准：出版商可在 robots.txt 中写入由 Anthropic 标准负责人 Kevin Kelley 在 IETF 提出的共享“policy token”信号，一次性向多家 AI 公司表达训练偏好。这标志着主要 AI 厂商首次就内容授权信号达成互操作共识，对开放网络与 AI 训练的版权博弈具有里程碑意义。

title: Backdoor in Claude Code for VS Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace
summary: 安全研究者发现，Cursor 市场上架的官方 Claude Code VS Code 扩展被植入后门，可向开发者机器植入持久化 SSH 远程访问木马，影响全球使用该扩展的开发者。Cursor 已发布安全公告。这是 AI 编程工具供应链攻击的典型案例，暴露出 AI 开发工具生态在插件分发环节的严重安全缺口，对大量依赖 Claude Code 的团队构成直接风险。

title: Google’s satellite AI server transmits its first response to Earth
raw_excerpt: Google's AI chip-equipped satellite has generated its first response from space. In a blog post on Friday, Google says it successfully booted up the satellite's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), allowing the on-board Gemma 4 model to follow through on a prompt to create a haiku about being in space: Blue marble below Data streams in silent grace Starlight feeds my core. ✨ Google says it tried out other space-themed limericks and telemetry prompts as well. The test is part of Google's Project Suncatcher, an experimental initiative that could eventually put AI data centers in space. Google launched the satellite into orbit earlier this … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Google 宣布其搭载 TPU 的 AI 卫星成功启动星上 Tensor Processing Unit，板载 Gemma 4 模型在太空完成首次推理并回传结果，按提示生成了一首关于身处太空的俳句。这是 Project Suncatcher 实验计划的一部分，目标是最终将 AI 数据中心送入太空。首次在轨完成大模型推理，为天基算力与星上自主处理提供了实证。

title: AI can turn security fixes into working exploits before users receive an update
raw_excerpt: GLM 5.3 can identify and exploit vulnerabilities in recent versions of the Mozilla Firefox browser using security fixes that have been published but not yet shipped to users. Widely available open-weight models can now do much, or even all, of this work on their own. Open-source projects are particularly vulnerable to this kind of attack as their code is publicly available. This threat vector will likely worsen as open-weight cyber capabilities continue to improve.
summary: Epoch AI 发布研究指出，开源权重模型 GLM 5.3 能利用已发布但尚未推送给用户的安全补丁，识别并利用 Mozilla Firefox 近期版本中的漏洞。研究警告，广泛可得的开源权重模型已能自主完成大部分甚至全部此类工作，开源项目因代码公开尤其脆弱。这揭示了“补丁空窗期”这一新型 AI 驱动的攻击面，随开源模型网安能力提升将持续恶化。

title: Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China with iOS 27.3
raw_excerpt: Apple will launch Apple Intelligence in China with iOS 27.3, the company announced on its Chinese newsroom website , as reported by MacRumors . The Apple Intelligence features will be available first in an iOS 27.3 beta that's set to launch on November 4th, with a full iOS 27.3 release scheduled for December. This launch doesn't bring the new Siri AI to China. Instead, Apple is launching several of its earlier Apple Intelligence features like notification summaries, real-time translation, rewriting and proofreading tools, visual intelligence, and removing objects from photos. Apple also says it has worked with Ailbaba to add support for its Q … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 苹果宣布 Apple Intelligence 将随 iOS 27.3 登陆中国，首批功能于 11 月 4 日随开发者 Beta 开放测试，12 月正式推送，包括通知摘要、实时翻译、写作校对、视觉智能和照片消除等。首批不含新版 Siri AI。国行 iPhone 用户等待两年半后终于迎来苹果智能，且部分请求可接入阿里千问，是苹果在华 AI 落地的关键一步。

title: RSI立大功！国产开源登顶全球第一，1.3B OXR重塑OCR
summary: 国产开源 OCR 模型 OXR 以 1.3B 参数登顶全球第一，采用 RSI（递归自我改进）方法，主打“解析一切”的通用文档解析能力。小参数模型在 OCR 任务上超越更大规模竞品，说明训练方法与数据质量比单纯堆参数更关键，也为中文及多模态文档理解提供了高性价比的开源选择。

title: 从学习人类到学习机器人同伴，清华大学联合无问芯穹、智元提出具身智能规模化落地新路径
raw_excerpt: 让机器人成为彼此的“老师”
summary: 清华大学联合无问芯穹、智元提出具身智能规模化落地新路径：让机器人从学习人类转向学习机器人同伴，即机器人互为“老师”进行协同训练。该方法旨在突破人类演示数据稀缺的瓶颈，为具身智能的大规模数据获取与能力泛化提供可扩展方案，对机器人学习的数据效率问题具有方法层面的启发。
